title: Validate EUR base save identity compatibility
changes: Verify snapshot and synthetic cartridge-save interchange in both directions between raw ROM mode and the unmodified E170 decoded base dataset, including transactional identity failures.
validation: Windows GNU build e170-save-identity-build-ztowooij and Wine e170-save-identity-wine-_mjaz8sl pass. Snapshot bytes match between modes, each mode loads the other snapshot, and synthetic cartridge saves move in both directions via restart persistence. Invalid magic, version, ROM/BIOS identity, checksum and payload leave machines unchanged; wrong-ROM dataset attachment is rejected, and invalid boot state leaves the existing synthetic save untouched. Owner status persists, protected inputs pass, Wine drains and successful scratch is removed.
limitations: Direct APIs and synthetic saves cover the unmodified EUR E170 base, not GUI behavior, game-specific save semantics, mods or deferred platforms. Cartridge saves remain raw game-format bytes without an added dataset identity header; arbitrary wrong-game saves are not authenticated by this test.
